text: その　おかげで　カツラは　ぶじ　やまを　おりることが　できたのさ

structure.jp: やまを　おりることが　できたのさ
structure.en: was able to get down the mountain, you see

patterns.name: 〜ことができる
patterns.span: おりることが　できた
patterns.explanation: A verb plus ことができる means 'can do' that thing. おりることが　できた = 'was able to get down'.

patterns.name: 〜おかげで
patterns.explanation: おかげで means 'thanks to', used when something good came out of it. その　おかげで = 'thanks to that'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feeling of explaining how things were, and さ is a breezy spoken ending used here in place of だ. できたのさ = 'he was able to, you see'.
